releaseNotes: feat: Add SFTP account details and username retrieval
changelog: Implemented API service method to fetch client account details.
Created data model for ClientAccountAttributes to represent account information.
Enhanced PteroRepository to cache and manage account usernames.
Updated PcApiRouter to include account username in server details response.
Modified UI components to display SFTP details and actions for copying credentials.
Added new strings for SFTP-related UI elements and actions.
Created unit tests for SFTP account retrieval and DTO serialization.
